messages.content: You are a senior security code reviewer.

Review exportWorkspaceData. It allows any member to export all messages including private_notes. Bug: only workspace owner/admin should export, and private_notes must be excluded unless include_private=true and requester has compliance_officer role. Required: add export_jobs table, status queued/running/done, max 2 exports/day/workspace, redact api_key and access_token fields.
Data leak: exportWorkspaceData permission too broad, private_notes special role, export_jobs states, 2/day/workspace, redact secrets.
